solutions.title: Find missing data
solutions.description: Compares two spreadsheets and instantly flags every email in Sheet B that's missing from Sheet A — a check that used to mean manually scanning hundreds of rows.

solutions.title: Data Cleaning Tool
solutions.description: Automatically fixes formatting, removes duplicates and stray whitespace, and flags invalid emails — turning a messy spreadsheet into clean, usable data in seconds.

solutions.title: Workbook Consolidation Tool
solutions.description: Pulls sheets from multiple separate workbooks and merges them into a single, unified workbook — no more manually copying tabs between files.

solutions.title: Column Matching & Merge Tool
solutions.description: Matches records by ID across two sheets and pulls the matching columns from Sheet 2 into Sheet 1 — replacing manual VLOOKUP-style cross-referencing.

solutions.title: Multi-Sheet Data Combiner
solutions.description: Merges data spread across multiple sheets — like separate January, February, March tabs — into one combined sheet, no manual copy-pasting required.

solutions.title: AI-Powered Data Cleaning Tool
solutions.description: Cleans messy spreadsheet data using AI — fixing formatting, removing duplicates, and correcting invalid entries with less manual rule-setting than a traditional script.
